segments.speaker: Linh
segments.text: Hi, Alex. The purchasing team needs a training session on the new S A P screen. Could we use the training room on Thursday?

segments.speaker: Alex
segments.text: The room is booked all Thursday. It's free on Friday morning, though.

segments.speaker: Linh
segments.text: Friday works. Let's start at nine and finish before eleven. There will be twelve participants.

segments.speaker: Alex
segments.text: All right. I'll book the room. Can you send me the participant list by tomorrow afternoon? I need it to create their training accounts.

segments.speaker: Linh
segments.text: Sure. I'll also ask everyone to bring a laptop.
